content: Alembic column split migration pattern: in a single revision's upgrade() function: (1) add new nullable columns with op.add_column; (2) execute a SQL backfill using op.execute() with a PostgreSQL expression like UPDATE people SET first_name = split_part(full_name, ' ', 1), last_name = split_part(full_name, ' ', -1); (3) optionally add NOT NULL constraints in a subsequent migration after verifying backfill. For full_name -> first/last/middle/suffix, the split must handle variable-length names — safer to do split_part for first and last and leave middle/suffix NULL initially, with operator manual filling. Keep full_name column for backward compatibility; add new columns alongside. Downgrade concatenates back with CONCAT_WS.' '.
